scope: Candidate-only actual public MusicAnalyzer replay against the preserved 350-graph original one-thread baseline. Final production Android stage routing is exercised with a probe-only Android.pickAudio marker, actual COI/SAB and navigator.hardwareConcurrency=8. This is host byte qualification, not a physical Android provider test or controlled timing.

input.construction: Original RIFF prefix and first 132300 stereo sample frames retained byte for byte; only RIFF and data chunk lengths updated.

controls.threadPolicy: Final Android production route: rhythm1, Precision separation4, voice4, bass1; actual COI/SAB and >=8 cores required.
controls.androidMarker: window.Android.pickAudio is a probe-only function; no method is called.
controls.checkpoints: Fresh independent browser context per run; same fixed analysisIdentity equal to WAV SHA256.

structure.method: Time-normalized tonal, energy and spectral fingerprints

timing.alignment: Neural pulse with local tempo and nearby measured PCM attacks

warnings: Vocal and instrumental estimates can contain bleed; neither is an isolated bass instrument.
Lead and backing singers share one vocal source; no lyrics or word alignment.

separation.name: Mel-Band RoFormer Deux
separation.method: Dual trained stereo source separation; Float32 bounded transformer with complete attention
separation.alignment: Original PCM clock; centered STFT and normalized overlap-add with complementary chunk crossfades
limitations: Vocal and instrumental estimates can contain bleed; neither is an isolated bass instrument.
Lead and backing singers share one vocal source; no lyrics or word alignment.

vocals.method: GAME Large neural sung-note boundaries and pitches, with separated-source expression and singing/speech evidence

timing.alignment: Neural note boundaries on the source PCM clock, gated by separated voice evidence; no word alignment

diagnostics.limitations: Separation bleed, layered voices, distortion, unvoiced consonants and rapid pitch changes can remain ambiguous. Pitch follows a dominant periodic voice, not every harmony. Articulation markers are not transcribed words.
diagnostics.confidenceMeaning: Containing voice phrase evidence, not a calibrated GAME note probability

diagnostics.limitations: Low-register harmonic estimates can include piano, low voice or tuned sustained drums. Brief or sweeping kick transients are suppressed; overlapping instruments, glides and quiet bass can be missed. Kicks overlapping a low note can still move its estimated boundary; the 5 ms boundary grid is not an accuracy guarantee.
diagnostics.boundaryMethod: Exact-frequency harmonic amplitudes in local PCM

limitations: Bass notes are estimated from combined accompaniment, not an isolated bass instrument.

roleAnalysis.vocalSource: Separated vocal waveform with singing and speech evidence

engine.name: Beat This! full + Deux + GAME Large
engine.detail: Bundled pretrained rhythm transformer, stereo vocal separation, isolated-voice singing and speech classification, GAME Large neural sung-note transcription, measured source expression, and independent accompaniment bass tracking. All audio stays on this device.
